scope: Compare equation-derived and E7-targeted nonhomomorphic selectors before any dynamical claim.
structural_gates: Enumerate nonzero exact triads separately from zero modes.
Enumerate nonzero barotropic interaction channels separately from PDE-zero support.
Require source-exchange, sign-inversion, and cyclic-triad closure.
Require exact selector counts at square-domain radii 2, 4, and 8.
Require instantaneous inviscid energy and enstrophy conservation before dynamics.
falsification_thresholds: Reject a selector that accepts all or no active channels.
Reject a selector that violates its declared symmetry or conservation gates.
Reject E7 specificity if the mask is exactly equivalent to the generic checkerboard-sublattice control.
Reject physical promotion until grid, bandwidth, and independent clean-environment reproduction gates pass.
interpretation_boundary: The E7 discriminant quadratic form is established mathematics. Using its defect as a barotropic interaction law is a new conjecture, not P/Q charge conservation.
